description: Defines the class 'radio_zmq_tx_channel' which manages a ZeroMQ-based radio transmit channel, including its configuration, state management, and data transmission methods.

classes.name: radio_zmq_tx_channel
classes.description: Manages a ZeroMQ socket for radio transmission, including configuration, starting/stopping, and data transmission.

methods.name: radio_zmq_tx_channel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the radio ZMQ transmit channel with context, configuration, notification handler, and executor.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the transmission channel at a specified initial time.
